sourceDifference: The corrected intervention index derives from actual national deployments. The other four cases have no military/drawdown outcomes, zero deployments and zero intervention index throughout. Their unchanged checkpoints are retained. A formatting-only signal-query reflow is also included.
performanceScope: Complete corrected intervention execution only; the four other scenarios retain their original clean checkpoints.

concurrencyValidation.scope: Two synthetic national commitments against real isolated sandbox Mongo, with a read barrier forcing both initial snapshots to collide. Existing long-run trajectories remain sequential evidence from their recorded source commits.
concurrencyValidation.regression: globalResponse.test.ts covers both existing campaign state and legacy rows without campaign state.
